top.prompt: A highly detailed, epic 2D anime illustration in a classic martial arts action style, 1:1 square aspect ratio. A single continuous, seamless, and unified landscape of rocky red canyons. On the far left, a spiky-haired martial artist in an orange and blue training uniform stands with a fierce grin, surrounded by a massive, roaring golden-yellow energy aura with crackling lightning. On the far right, a warrior with dark flame-shaped hair stands with crossed arms and a cocky smirk, surrounded by a glowing cyan and blue energy aura. The entire middle-center area of the canyon floor is a flat, clean, dark-red dry soil surface with no rocks or details. Vibrant saturated colors, intense explosive action atmosphere, dynamic cel-shading, bold outlines. --ar 1:1 --no text, watermark, signature, UI, buttons, split screen, panels

loader.description: Pantalla de carga: Goku vs Freezer jugando una partida REAL y correcta de Magic. Vertical 9:16 mobile.
loader.prompt: A humorous and epic 2D anime illustration in the classic Dragon Ball Z style, vertical portrait composition, aspect ratio 9:16. Goku (base form) and Frieza (Final Form) are seated properly and facing each other across a flat stone table, playing a card game of Magic: The Gathering. Goku is concentrated with a funny expression, while Frieza smirks holding a hand of glowing cards. Both characters hold their cards facing themselves (only the card backs are visible to the camera). On the table is a detailed Magic: The Gathering battlefield: rows of fantasy cards with some cards turned horizontally at 90-degree angle to indicate they are tapped, and a small blue energy aura hologram. Warm landscape lighting, vibrant cel-shading. --ar 9:16 --no text, watermark, signature, UI, buttons, backward cards

preview.description: Lobby: Goku vs Freezer jugando una partida de Magic en el desierto. Horizontal 16:9.
preview.prompt: A humorous and epic 2D anime scene of a card match in the classic Dragon Ball Z style, wide landscape composition, aspect ratio 16:9. Goku (base form) and Frieza (Final Form) are seated properly and facing each other across a flat stone table in a rocky desert canyon. Goku is looking intensely focused and scratching his head over a hand of cards, while Frieza smirks confidently holding his hand. Both characters hold their cards facing themselves (only the card backs are visible to the camera, no upside-down cards). On the table is a detailed Magic: The Gathering battlefield: rows of fantasy cards, with some cards turned horizontally at 90-degree angle to show they are tapped, and a glowing orange four-star Dragon Ball sitting next to their decks. Vibrant cel-shading, bright dramatic sky. --ar 16:9 --no text, watermark, signature, UI, buttons, backward cards
